{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = trial['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_count}')

# Show the sample_seq for one of the duplicated patients
sample_seq_by_patient = trial[['patient_id', 'sample_seq']].groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Unique max sample_seq per patient: {sample_seq_by_patient.nunique()}')"}
